# Exchange create helpers move their by-value completion callback at its last use

Both create helpers receive onComplete by value and pass std::move(onComplete) to the handler constructor at its last local use. The constructor also receives by value and moves the callback into mOnComplete for later remote completion/error callbacks. Go still reports whether the asynchronous operation started. This is the checked callable-forwarding path, not a measured allocation/copy count or a rule to move borrowed callback arguments.

Scope: Exchange message creation callback ownership.
